name: Battles
overview: Scripture reveals that battles, whether physical or spiritual, are ultimately fought and won through the Lord's power and presence. God promises to fight for His people and strengthen them in the face of fear and opposition, assuring them of His help and righteous support. The believer is called to trust in God's protection rather than relying on worldly philosophies or deceit that can lead the mind astray. This includes the internal struggle of guarding one's thoughts, as seen in warnings against being led away from Christ-centered truth.
